basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-resolution full-screen background for a cozy mobile game bar interior.
Input image: supplied image is the edit target and visual-quality reference.
Recreate this same richly detailed, softly rendered 3D clay-like cozy bar at high resolution, ideally 3072x2048 pixels, landscape 3:2. Preserve the centered cute adult bartender with rounded dark hair, white shirt and black vest holding a cocktail shaker, warmly illuminated backbar bottles, hanging stemware, four cushioned bar stools, wood counter, pendant lamps, plants, and wood/brick textures. Keep the bartender and key shelving centered for portrait cover-cropping. Palette: classic warm walnut wood, cream upholstery, honey amber light, olive green plants.
REMOVE the entire foreground UI dialog, its Chinese text, both yes/no buttons, and the hand cursor. Reconstruct the unobscured bar-stool legs and wooden floor behind them naturally. No overlay, no interface, no border, no watermark. Only the small physical wall sign may say "Bar". Render sharp, clean detailed edges and readable material detail throughout rather than blurry thumbnail detail; keep gentle natural depth but no heavy blur. One complete bar scene only, NOT a collage or contact sheet.
